question: An article is marked at Rs. 700. If it is sold at a discount of 35%, then the selling price become (5)/(3) times of its cost price. What is its cost price (in Rs.)?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = 700, Discount = 35 %

**Solution:**

Selling price = 700 × (100 - 35) / 100

⇒ 700 × 65 / 100

⇒ 455
